row: Healing Arts Animal Care provides veterinary acupuncture, rehabilitation therapy, physical therapy and athletic conditioning to the dogs and cats of Grants Pass and of Portland, OR. We strive to create a team among you, your pet, your veterinarian and ourselves to create a whole package of care for your pet. Pets come through our door knowing that we’re going to have fun here and this isn’t “another trip to the vet.”  These videos show our tools (laser, underwater treadmill/hydrotherapy, ultrasound, physiotherapy, exercises, manual therapy, acupuncture) and how we use them to help your pet recovery from surgery or neurologic injury or your older dog maintain function and quality of life.  We also do conditioning for athletic dogs -- agility, lure coursing, flyball and more!
